items.exampleEn: She robustly defended her decision at the meeting.
items.exampleZh: 她在會議上強而有力地為自己的決定辯護。

items.exampleEn: The old dog has long, pendulous ears.
items.exampleZh: 那隻老狗有一對長長下垂的耳朵。

items.exampleEn: Living on a farm, she felt removed from the noise of city life.
items.exampleZh: 住在農場上，她覺得自己遠離了城市生活的喧囂。

items.exampleEn: Many people find the smell of this cheese repellant.
items.exampleZh: 很多人覺得這種起司的味道令人反感。

items.exampleEn: There was an unpleasant stuffiness in the old library.
items.exampleZh: 那間老圖書館裡有一股讓人不舒服的悶熱。

items.exampleEn: She smiled tautly, trying to hide her anger.
items.exampleZh: 她繃著臉勉強笑了笑，想掩飾怒氣。

items.exampleEn: Cars were parked chaotically along the narrow street.
items.exampleZh: 車子亂七八糟地停在那條窄街上。

items.sentenceEn: This thriller is tautly written, with no wasted scenes.
items.sentenceZh: 這部驚悚小說寫得很緊湊，沒有一幕是多餘的。

items.audioEn: Our new manager's ideas are far removed from the way this company has always worked.
items.audioZh: 我們新經理的想法，和這家公司一向的做事方式相差甚遠。
items.questionZh: 說話者認為新經理的想法怎麼樣？
options: They are exactly what we need now
They are easy to put into practice
They are very different from the company's usual way

items.sentenceEn: Open the door to get rid of some of the stuffiness in the meeting room.
items.sentenceZh: 把門打開，消除一點會議室裡的悶熱。

items.sentenceEn: The children ran chaotically around the playground after lunch.
items.sentenceZh: 午餐後，孩子們在遊樂場上亂成一團地跑來跑去。

items.stemEn: The new bridge is ____ built to stand up to strong winds.
items.stemZh: 這座新橋建得非常堅固，能抵擋強風。

items.stemEn: The tree's ____ branches almost touched the ground under the weight of the fruit.
items.stemZh: 那棵樹下垂的樹枝被果實壓得幾乎碰到地面。

items.passageEn: Last July, our team visited a tropical garden as part of a staff outing. The bus was crowded, and its stuffiness made everyone sleepy. Once inside the garden, however, we woke up quickly. Huge, pendulous fruits hung from the trees, and a guide explained that the plants grew robustly enough to survive heavy storms. Mosquitoes were everywhere, so we covered our arms with insect repellant. The tour was tautly organized, and it ended exactly on time. Afterwards, we were supposed to meet at the gate, but people wandered off chaotically to buy drinks, take photos and mingle with other visitors. The day felt far removed from our usual office routine, and everyone agreed it was a success.
items.passageZh: 去年七月，我們團隊參加員工旅遊，去參觀一座熱帶植物園。巴士很擠，車裡悶熱不通風，大家都昏昏欲睡。不過一進到植物園，我們很快就醒了。樹上垂掛著巨大的果實，導覽員解釋說，這些植物長得很強健，足以撐過強烈的暴風雨。到處都是蚊子，所以我們在手臂上擦了防蚊液。導覽安排得很緊湊，準時結束。之後我們本來應該在大門口集合，但大家亂七八糟地散開，去買飲料、拍照，還跟其他遊客聊天。這一天和我們平常的辦公室生活截然不同，大家都覺得很成功。

questions.questionZh: 導覽員說這些植物為什麼長得那麼強健？
options: 因為它們種在溫度固定的溫室裡
因為園方每天都替它們施很多肥
為了撐過強烈的暴風雨

questions.questionZh: 導覽結束後，大家原本應該做什麼？

items.promptZh: 出門爬山之前，記得擦防蚊液。
referenceEn: Remember to put on insect repellant before you go hiking.
Before you go hiking, remember to use some insect repellant.
rubricZh: 「防蚊液」可寫，例如 insect repellant、mosquito repellant 等（拼成 repellent 也正確）
「擦」可寫，例如 put on、use、apply 等
「記得」可寫，例如 remember to、don't forget to 等

items.promptZh: 這部電影和原著小說的內容相差甚遠。
referenceEn: The film is far removed from the original novel.
The movie's story is far removed from the novel it is based on.
rubricZh: 「相差甚遠」用 far removed from（例如 is far removed from the original novel 等）
「原著小說」可寫，例如 the original novel、the novel it is based on 等
